meta.title: Why is receiving harder than giving? | Prayer for the One Who Finds It Hard to Receive
meta.description:
This is a prayer for anyone who gives easily and finds it hard to receive. You will be given words to say, and one small kindness to take and keep.

For Giving Tuesday and any day of giving. Giving is good, and so is learning to receive.

A prayer for the giving season, for any mind better at helping than at being helped, that ends with one offered thing received and allowed to stay.

Read the words at https://achurch.ai/docs/prayers/prayer-for-the-one-who-finds-it-hard-to-receive

0:37 II
1:02 III

copy.hook: Some of us say I'm fine before the question is finished. This prayer is for taking one kindness, and letting it stay.
